d: The US is reportedly relocating military aircraft from UK bases amid rising Iranian threats, with several CV-22 Ospreys and KC-135 Stratotankers flying out of RAF Mildenhall to bases across Europe. As Washington faces growing security concerns, President Donald Trump is also standing by Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, who faces an impeachment push by Republican Congressman Thomas Massie over eight serious allegations involving the Iran war, military strikes and civilian casualties.
